title: "Nearest topics and CPC groups of each technology (draft)"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    self_contained: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Draft, not on the site. For each of the 43 technologies of the grants (data/processed/tech_minplus_technologies.csv):
# the 100 nearest OpenAlex topics and CPC main groups by embedding (py/05v3_1s_simple.py,
# data/processed/tech_v3_1s_rank_{oa,cpc}.csv.gz), in two layouts:
#   A  radial: distance from the centre = how much less similar than the closest item; angle = subfield / subclass
#   C  strip:  cosine on the x axis, one row per subfield / subclass
# Ranks 1-50 went to the judge. If the judge consensus exists (data/processed/tech_profile_v3_1s.csv, made by
# py/05v3_1s_judge_consensus.py), each candidate shows its verdict; otherwise only candidate / not a candidate.
# Black ring: also chosen by v1 (data/processed/tech_profile_v1_levels.csv; reference only, not a benchmark).
# Colours: Okabe-Ito (colour-blind safe), and the verdict is also coded by the marker shape.
# Render: Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("reports/drafts/tech_neighbours.Rmd")'
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))
library(dplyr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(purrr); library(plotly); library(htmltools); library(here)
CUT <- 50
STATUS <- tibble(
  status = c("in profile", "about it, not taken (limit 2)", "rejected by the judge", "candidate (no verdict yet)",
             "rank 51-100, not judged"),
  color  = c("#0072b2", "#56b4e9", "#d55e00", "#0072b2", "#9a9a9a"),
  symbol = c("circle", "circle", "x", "circle", "circle"),
  size   = c(13, 10, 9, 9, 7),
  alpha  = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.35))

techs <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_minplus_technologies.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  distinct(engine_name, tech_id, tech_label) |> arrange(engine_name, tech_id)
v1 <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_profile_v1_levels.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
jf <- here("data", "processed", "tech_profile_v3_1s.csv")
judge <- if (file.exists(jf)) read_csv(jf, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(item_id = "c")) else NULL

ranks <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_v3_1s_rank_oa.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    transmute(kind = "oa", engine_name, tech_id, id = topic_id, title = topic, cat = subfield, score, rank),
  read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_v3_1s_rank_cpc.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    transmute(kind = "cpc", engine_name, tech_id, id = cpc, title = group_title, cat = subclass, score, rank)) |>
  filter(rank <= 100) |>
  left_join(v1 |> transmute(kind, engine_name, tech_id, id = item_id, in_v1 = TRUE),
            by = c("kind", "engine_name", "tech_id", "id")) |>
  mutate(in_v1 = coalesce(in_v1, FALSE))
if (!is.null(judge)) {
  ranks <- ranks |> left_join(judge |> transmute(kind, engine_name, tech_id, id = item_id, n_about, mean_score,
                                                 in_profile, s = paste(score1, score2, score3, sep = "/")),
                              by = c("kind", "engine_name", "tech_id", "id"))
} else ranks <- ranks |> mutate(n_about = NA_real_, mean_score = NA_real_, in_profile = NA, s = NA_character_)
ranks <- ranks |>
  mutate(status = case_when(rank > CUT ~ "rank 51-100, not judged",
                            is.na(in_profile) ~ "candidate (no verdict yet)",
                            in_profile ~ "in profile",
                            n_about >= 2 ~ "about it, not taken (limit 2)",
                            TRUE ~ "rejected by the judge")) |>
  left_join(STATUS, by = "status") |>
  group_by(kind, engine_name, tech_id) |> mutate(dist = max(score) - score) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(hover = sprintf("<b>%s</b> %s<br>%s<br>rank %d, cosine %.3f<br>%s%s%s", id, title, cat, rank, score, status,
                         if_else(is.na(s), "", paste0(" (judge scores ", s, ")")),
                         if_else(in_v1, "<br><i>also chosen by v1</i>", "")))

short <- \(x, n) if_else(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 3), "..."), x)
marker <- \(d) list(color = d$color, opacity = d$alpha, size = d$size, symbol = d$symbol,
                    line = list(color = if_else(d$in_v1, "#000000", "#ffffff"), width = if_else(d$in_v1, 2.5, 0.8)))

# A: radial. Sectors = categories ordered by their best rank, sized by number of items
radial <- function(d, title) {
  # sectors: categories with 3+ items, ordered by their best rank; smaller ones pooled into one sector, last
  d <- d |> add_count(cat, name = "n_cat") |> mutate(sec = if_else(n_cat >= 3, cat, "other (1-2 items each)")) |>
    arrange(rank)
  ord <- d |> group_by(sec) |> summarise(best = min(rank), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(sec == "other (1-2 items each)", best) |>
    mutate(start = 360 * (cumsum(n) - n) / sum(n), width = 360 * n / sum(n), mid = start + width / 2,
           shade = if_else(row_number() %% 2 == 1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.06)", "rgba(0,0,0,0)"))
  d <- d |> left_join(ord, by = "sec") |> group_by(sec) |>
    mutate(theta = start + width * (rank(rank) - 0.5) / n()) |> ungroup() |> arrange(rank)
  # the technology is the centre; radius = a fixed gap + how much less similar than the closest item
  gap <- 0.2 * max(d$dist); r <- gap + d$dist; cr <- gap + d$dist[d$rank == CUT]; R <- max(r) * 1.04
  k <- which(d$rank <= CUT)
  plot_ly(width = 560, height = 480) |>
    add_trace(type = "barpolar", r = rep(R, nrow(ord)), theta = ord$mid, width = ord$width, hoverinfo = "skip",
              marker = list(color = ord$shade, line = list(width = 0)), showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_trace(type = "scatterpolar", mode = "lines", r = as.vector(rbind(0, r[k], NA)),   # rays of the candidates
              theta = as.vector(rbind(d$theta[k], d$theta[k], NA)), connectgaps = FALSE,
              hoverinfo = "skip", line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.13)", width = 1), showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_trace(type = "scatterpolar", mode = "lines", r = rep(cr, 361), theta = 0:360, hoverinfo = "skip",
              line = list(color = "#0072b2", dash = "dash", width = 1.5), showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_trace(type = "scatterpolar", mode = "markers", r = r, theta = d$theta, text = d$hover, hoverinfo = "text",
              marker = marker(d), showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_trace(type = "scatterpolar", mode = "markers", r = 0, theta = 0, text = "the technology", hoverinfo = "text",
              marker = list(size = 16, color = "#ffffff", line = list(color = "#000000", width = 2)), showlegend = FALSE) |>
    layout(title = list(text = title, font = list(size = 14)),
           polar = list(bargap = 0,
                        radialaxis = list(range = c(0, R), showticklabels = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE, ticks = "", showline = FALSE),
                        angularaxis = list(tickvals = ord$mid, ticktext = short(ord$sec, 22), ticks = "",
                                           tickfont = list(size = 10), showgrid = FALSE)),
           margin = list(t = 50, l = 135, r = 135, b = 30))
}
# C: strip. Rows = categories with 2+ items, the rest pooled
strip <- function(d, title) {
  d <- d |> add_count(cat) |> mutate(row = if_else(n >= 2, short(cat, 40), "(other, 1 item each)"))
  lv <- d |> group_by(row) |> summarise(b = min(rank)) |> arrange(desc(b)) |> pull(row)
  d <- d |> mutate(row = factor(row, levels = lv))
  plot_ly(d, width = 1080, height = 120 + 20 * length(lv), x = ~score, y = ~row, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
          text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", marker = marker(d)) |>
    layout(title = list(text = title, font = list(size = 14)),
           xaxis = list(title = "cosine (further right = closer)", zeroline = FALSE),
           yaxis = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 10)),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = d$score[d$rank == CUT], x1 = d$score[d$rank == CUT], y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                              yref = "paper", line = list(color = "#0072b2", dash = "dash"))),
           margin = list(l = 260, t = 50))
}
legend_html <- function() {
  sym <- \(st) if (st$symbol == "x") sprintf('<b style="color:%s">&#10005;</b>', st$color) else
    sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%%;background:%s;opacity:%s"></span>',
            st$color, st$alpha)
  used <- STATUS |> filter(status %in% ranks$status)
  HTML(paste0('<p style="font-size:13px">', paste(map_chr(seq_len(nrow(used)), \(i) paste(sym(used[i, ]), used$status[i])),
                                                 collapse = " &nbsp; "),
              ' &nbsp; <span style="display:inline-block;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid #000"></span> also chosen by v1',
              ' &nbsp; <span style="color:#0072b2">- - -</span> cut at rank ', CUT, '</p>'))
}
```

The 100 nearest OpenAlex topics and CPC main groups of each technology of the grants, by embedding similarity.
Ranks 1-`r CUT` go to the LLM judge; ranks `r CUT + 1`-100 are shown faded, to see what did not make the cut.
`r if (is.null(judge)) "**The judge's verdicts are not in yet**: candidates are shown without a verdict." else "Verdicts: consensus of three judge runs."`
**A** (radial): the technology is the centre; distance from it = a fixed gap plus how much less similar the item is
than the closest one. Shaded and white sectors are OpenAlex subfields or CPC subclasses (the label names the whole
sector); subfields or subclasses with 1-2 items share the sector \"other\". **C** (strip): the cosine itself, one row per subfield or subclass.
Hover a point for its title, rank, cosine and scores. v1 is shown for reference only; it is not a benchmark.

```{r legend}
legend_html()
```

```{r pages}
engines <- unique(techs$engine_name)
sel <- tags$select(id = "engine-select", class = "form-control", style = "width:auto; margin-bottom:10px",
                   map(seq_along(engines), \(j) tags$option(value = j, engines[j])))
# one row of buttons per Engine, one button per technology
btns <- map(seq_along(engines), \(j) {
  ks <- which(techs$engine_name == engines[j])
  div(class = "tech-btns", `data-e` = j, style = if (j > 1) "display:none" else NULL,
      map(ks, \(i) tags$button(type = "button", class = "btn btn-default btn-sm tech-btn", `data-k` = i,
                                style = "margin:0 6px 6px 0", sprintf("%d. %s", techs$tech_id[i], techs$tech_label[i]))))
})
row <- \(...) div(style = "display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap", ...)
panes <- map(seq_len(nrow(techs)), \(i) {
  d <- ranks |> filter(engine_name == techs$engine_name[i], tech_id == techs$tech_id[i])
  oa <- d |> filter(kind == "oa"); cpc <- d |> filter(kind == "cpc")
  div(class = "tech-pane", `data-k` = i, `data-e` = match(techs$engine_name[i], engines),
      style = if (i > 1) "display:none" else NULL,
      h3(sprintf("%s: %s", techs$engine_name[i], techs$tech_label[i])),
      h4("A. Radial"), row(radial(oa, "Topics"), radial(cpc, "CPC groups")),
      h4("C. Strip"), strip(oa, "Topics"), strip(cpc, "CPC groups"))
})
tagList(sel, btns, panes)
```

<style>
.tech-btn.active { background: #0072b2; border-color: #0072b2; color: #fff; }
</style>
<script>
// Engine list, then one button per technology of that Engine; the choice goes into the address (#tech-<k>)
function showTech(k) {
  var pane = document.querySelector('.tech-pane[data-k="' + k + '"]');
  if (!pane) return;
  var e = pane.getAttribute("data-e");
  document.getElementById("engine-select").value = e;
  document.querySelectorAll(".tech-btns").forEach(function (d) { d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-e") === e ? "" : "none"; });
  document.querySelectorAll(".tech-btn").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b.getAttribute("data-k") === String(k)); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".tech-pane").forEach(function (d) { d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-k") === String(k) ? "" : "none"; });
  history.replaceState(null, "", "#tech-" + k);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));  // plotly sizes hidden plots on show
}
document.getElementById("engine-select").addEventListener("change", function () {
  var first = document.querySelector('.tech-btns[data-e="' + this.value + '"] .tech-btn');
  showTech(first.getAttribute("data-k"));  // an Engine opens on its first technology
});
document.querySelectorAll(".tech-btn").forEach(function (b) {
  b.addEventListener("click", function () { showTech(b.getAttribute("data-k")); });
});
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#tech-(\d+)$/);
  showTech(m ? m[1] : 1);
});
</script>
